svg.title: Soft vinyl — Source, Transform, Store
svg.desc: Five soft-touch vinyl primitives composing a pipeline figure, moulded in a warm terracotta ramp. Three label-bearing slabs read Source on an event stream, Transform doing map and filter, and Store to a warehouse, joined left to right by two capsule connectors; a numbered sphere badge sits on each slab. Below, a five-cylinder series labelled Q1 through Q5 stands at relative heights 40, 72, 32, 80 and 52, so Q4 is tallest and Q3 shortest. Every silhouette carries a seeded low-frequency wobble, so no edge is mathematically straight and no two forms are identical — the irregularity of a hand-shaped mass, with the surface left grain-free. Every form is lit by one upper-left key, its shadow edge glowing warm rather than going dark, and each rests on a warm brown contact shadow offset along that light. The Transform slab squashes and settles once per loop like a stop-motion take.
svg.text: terracotta ramp, jitter 0.85 — hand-formed silhouettes, no surface grain

g.text: Labels sit on slabs, never on a shaded form
volume lives in the fill — strip every filter and the forms still read solid
